[P2] Materialize pending parents before installing fallback references

When the full input snapshot contains updated terminal context P, terminal child C, and an unavailable parent of P, this loop installs a `DurableParentSpan` for P before processing P's deferred completion. `_finish_operation_end` then treats that entry as an existing span: its `end()` does nothing, but P enters `_ended_operation_ids` without being exported. The nested-fallback test misses this because `operations` is empty. Materialize pending parent completions before installing fallback-only references, and test this hierarchy with the full snapshot populated.
